text: *ST萃华公告，公司持股5%以上股东深圳市翠艺投资有限公司一致行动人郭英杰近日收到中国证监会《立案告知书》，因其涉嫌信息披露违法违规，中国证监会决定对郭英杰立案。
text_en: *ST Cuihua announced that Guo Yingjie, a person acting in concert with shareholder Shenzhen Cuiyi Investment Co., Ltd. holding over 5% of shares, recently received a 'Case Filing Notice' from the CSRC. Due to suspected violations of information disclosure laws and regulations, the CSRC has decided to file a case against Guo Yingjie.
